Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full prescription-refill payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Refill prescriptions","subtitle":"Select the medications to refill","medications":[{"id":"m1","name":"Atorvastatin","dosage":"20 mg tablet","supplyText":"3 days left","status":"low","refillsLeft":2},{"id":"m2","name":"Lisinopril","dosage":"10 mg tablet","supplyText":"In stock","status":"ok","refillsLeft":5},{"id":"m3","name":"Metformin","dosage":"500 mg tablet","supplyText":"No refills left","status":"out","refillsLeft":0}],"pharmacy":{"name":"Walgreens · Market St","address":"700 Market St","hours":"Open until 10 PM"},"submitText":"Request refill"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading; defaults to 'Refill prescriptions'.
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short line under the title.
- 'medications' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): the medications available to refill. Each MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back on selection) and 'name' (string). Optional per medication: 'dosage' (string, e.g. '20 mg tablet'); 'supplyText' (string, a short supply note e.g. '3 days left' or 'In stock'); 'status' (string; one of 'ok','low','out' — drives the supply pill color: ok=green, low=amber, out=red; defaults to 'ok'); 'refillsLeft' (integer). A medication with status 'out' is shown but NOT selectable (the customer must contact their provider to renew it).
- 'pharmacy' (object, optional but recommended): the pickup pharmacy shown at the foot. 'name' (string), 'address' (string, optional), 'hours' (string, optional).
- 'submitText' (string, optional): confirm-button label; defaults to 'Request refill'. The button shows the count of selected medications.

Keep the medication list to what the customer is refilling now; do not include broader clinical history. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
